acceptance_rules: Every replication must satisfy the unchanged per-case rule in the base protocol.
No threshold, scenario, seed, or source contract may be changed after an observed result.
All declared fail-closed controls must remain non-qualified or retain their explicitly declared transport-control status.
This campaign is confirmation only: it does not tune a wind estimator or open a 17-error-state branch.

retention.commit: compact aggregate summaries, failed-case records if any, input count, and canonical record digest
retention.do_not_commit: per-sample source streams, full per-seed records, build logs, or plots
